What you need

  • ✓A layered PSD drops straight in — top-level groups become trait types, the layers inside them become traits. Multiple PSDs with matching canvas sizes merge into one project.
  • ✓Or your layered art as transparent PNGs — one folder per trait type (Backgrounds, Bodies, Hats…), one PNG per trait — as folders, loose files, or a .zip of trait folders.
  • ✓Every PNG the same canvas size, with the character in the same position in every file — layers stack exactly as exported.
  • ✓Trait names as file names — tinfoil-hat.png becomes the trait “tinfoil-hat” in the preview, the rarity sheet and the metadata.
  • ✓Real transparency in the PNGs (alpha channel) — upper layers must let lower layers show through.

PSD is a first-class intake. Drop a layered PSD: top-level groups become trait types, the layers inside become traits, hidden layers are skipped, and every trait is placed on the full project canvas at its exact PSD offset. Several PSDs with matching canvas sizes merge into one project. Procreate: a .procreate file is tried through the ZIP door — if its layer images can't be read reliably, export a PSD or PNG folders from the Procreate app and drop those instead. Everything runs in your browser: your art is never uploaded to a server.

About these sets. Scout-667 is an original bot investigator drawn programmatically for this forge — six Backgrounds, six chassis Bodies, seven visor Faces, five Headgear options plus None, and four handheld Gear options plus None. Every layer is rendered as shapes on transparent canvas, so what stacks in the preview is exactly what exports in the ZIP: PNG images, a combined metadata.json, and a traits.csv rarity sheet. The Photoreal HD Field Units are four finished showcase renders (1280px+), kept as portraits. NOIR DESK is the layered photoreal set: 6 full-bleed Backgrounds, 6 photoreal bot-investigator Figures shot on flat chroma-green and keyed to transparency in your browser, 5 Visors, 5 Headgear, 4 Gear and 4 Atmosphere overlays (screen-blended) — 30 generated HD assets, one identical head-and-shoulders framing, that stack, pin, weigh, generate and export exactly like Scout-667.
